rule: Three tracks: Single bet, Parlay, Player prop combo
detail: Track definitions follow the official bet-type terminology.
A strategy appears on the ranked leaderboard only after passing G01-G13.
Out-of-sample score; numeric formula and weights are blank and flagged until pre-registered.
Evaluation windows and pre-registration hashes are frozen before scoring.
Non-monetary badges: Verified Signal, Top Single Bet, Top Parlay, Top Player Prop Combo. Reward values are blank and flagged.
Parlay strategies carry a stricter gate because official state data shows higher loss rates for parlays.
Ranks, scores and sample sizes are published only when verified; otherwise the cells are blank.
